en.answer: In the proposed scenario, if the effect of <<11948>> is activated, during the resolution the card in the Pendulum Zone is destroyed, it is not sent to the Graveyard and it is added to your Extra Deck face-up, then that Pendulum Monster that was added to your Extra Deck is placed in your Pendulum Zone.
en.question: If the card in the opponent's Pendulum Zone destroyed by the effect of <<11948>> is a card you own, how does this resolve?

ja.answer: 質問の状況で「<<11948>>」の効果を発動した場合、その効果処理によって破壊されたペンデュラムゾーンのカードは墓地へ送られず、元々の持ち主である自分のエクストラデッキに加わる事になりますが、そのエクストラデッキに加わったペンデュラムモンスターは、自分のペンデュラムゾーンに置かれる事になります。
